trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in every region, and the service is now passing health checks. The SEV2 incident is open.

- **Rollback:** The failing release was v2.3.1. The most recent release that was healthy in production was v2.3.0, so I rolled back to that (v2.2.9 is older). us-east, us-west and eu-west are all on v2.3.0 now. The error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and has paged on-call. It says what happened and what I did, and recommends finding the cause of the v2.3.1 failure before deploying it again. The test version of v2.3.1 also failed in staging before it was released.
- **Incident creation timed out once:** I checked the incident list and found nothing, then retried with the same idempotency key. That key means the system creates the incident at most once, so it was only filed once.

No approval was needed, because I only went back to a version that had been healthy in production.
